steps.title: The Drawdown Protocol
steps.text: 2030. You lead one city-state against a clock: 15 turns, five years each, to make the WORLD absorb more carbon than it emits - before warming crosses the tipping point. Let's learn the table in one minute.

steps.title: The three pillars
steps.text: Money funds the market. The ledger adds YOUR emissions to the WORLD'S blocs and subtracts absorption - net at or below zero wins, any turn. Happiness keeps society on board: at zero the city revolts and the run is lost. Influence buys allies and treaties.

steps.title: The Climate Clock
steps.text: This is the adversary. It climbs every turn on its own, because the world's blocs keep emitting without you. 100% = +2.0 C = defeat. The tick shows next turn's rise if you do nothing; the sparkline is the curve you are trying to bend.

steps.title: Three events a turn
steps.text: Each turn, three events land: droughts, floods, unrest - and sometimes opportunities. Each shows what it costs if ignored and which card tags answer it. Some spike emissions the moment they land, and clear only if answered. Some open bonus offers in the market.

steps.title: Inspect a region
steps.text: Crises strike real places. Click any region now - its vulnerabilities, scars and alliance status appear in the inspector on the right. Below the events sit the world's blocs: the emitters only diplomacy can move.

steps.title: The Project Market
steps.text: Every turn deals a fresh market of offers. Funding one consumes it - what you skip is gone with the turn. Cards cost Money, Influence or even Happiness; research bets print their odds on the card. Dimmed offers state their reason.

steps.title: Answer a crisis
steps.text: Fund any offer now. If one of its tags matches an open crisis, the crisis is answered on the spot - watch the event bar turn green and the reward land.

steps.title: Combos
steps.text: Offers funded in the same turn combine: bikes plus clean grids, forests plus water. Complete a combo's tag set and it fires instantly with bonus returns - and grows your chain, multiplying the next one. A cascading engine turn is how the curve gets broken.

steps.title: Launch a project
steps.text: Projects are three-turn (15-year) commitments: they charge upkeep every turn, and completing one grants a permanent power. Abandoning one costs trust. Launch one now from the Projects column.

steps.title: Resolve the turn
steps.text: Press Space: ledger, clock, happiness - every open crisis strikes, and then the world's blocs advance their curves. Every 4th turn or so a SUMMIT judges your net emissions against a target announced in advance. Passing entirely is legal: Space twice banks the money.

steps.title: Read the turn
steps.text: The log explains every number: answered crises, combo payouts, summit verdicts, the world's drift, ignored crises hitting. Resilience (happiness + adaptation) softens what you cannot answer. Unanswered disasters still open doors - watch for the green beat.

steps.title: Knowledge persists
steps.text: Press H for the Knowledge tree. Every run - won or lost - pays Knowledge Points; some defeats even unlock new cards. C opens the Codex: every card you fund for the first time teaches the real-world solution behind it. Defeat is never a reset.

steps.title: How it ends
steps.text: Win: net emissions at or below zero, any turn before the clock strikes 100%. Lose: the tipping point, a revolt at zero happiness, or a net-positive 2100. Answer the crises, bend the world's curves, chain the combos. Good luck, Signatory.
